column1: # Columns (TAB-separated): manifest file, expected server message, make-raw-set.py args.
# Expected = the 400 body's "error" minus its "set manifest is invalid: " prefix, copied
# from chute internal/set/set.go (Decode) and archive.go (Parse, readBounded) at chute
# main 50322eaf44c39f2002dfdcb066a03c5b8200546f. Item indices are 0-based manifest positions.
# VALID  = the server stores it as a set (201) and chute-set.py check prints nothing.
# ACCEPT = the server stores it as a set (201) but check reports it "producer-only:"
#          (mis-cased key: Go's decoder folds case, the phone's kotlinx decoder does not;
#          a local header name that differs from the central directory: Go never reads
#          it, Python's zipfile refuses the member, so the mirror cannot vouch for it).
# Hand-kept until chute publishes internal/set/testdata (spec, Changes needed in chute, 3).
